firmware.title: NES
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; QuickNES
firmware.description: A NES / Famicom / Dendy on QuickNES, with expansion audio and save states. A ROM browser with cover art on the SD card.
firmware.controls: NES/SNES/USB pad or keyboard (arrows, Z, X, Enter, Space). Select+Start or F12: settings.
